_comment: Events are the rooms with no checkable acceptance — a fork, a trade, a call somebody has to make. sts-fidelity.md refuses giving these an intent, because a judgement call has no honest telegraph. Effect verbs follow design/spire-ai/content-schema.md: add_curse, remove_curse, gain_relic, gain_card, lose_card, gain_focus, spend_focus, bump_prior, require_card, log_room. `greedy` marks the choice that trades a real liability for a real gain; the client tints exactly that one with danger and never the others.

events.title: Just One More Requirement
events.body: A stakeholder adds a "tiny" must-have before ship. Accepting expands this feature room into an elite.

choices.label: Accept scope
choices.consequence: Gain the Bloated Scope curse, permanently.

choices.label: Park in backlog
choices.consequence: Log it and leave. No curse.

events.title: The Rewrite Offer
events.body: Someone has a branch that replaces the whole module. It is cleaner. It is also unreviewed and three weeks old.

choices.label: Merge it
choices.consequence: Gain a rare card. Gain the Unreviewed Rewrite curse.

choices.label: Harvest one idea
choices.consequence: Gain a common card. Close the branch.

events.title: The Quiet Dependency
events.body: A library you rely on has not shipped in two years. It works. Its issue tracker is closed.

choices.label: Vendor it
choices.consequence: Gain the Vendored Fork relic. You own it now.

choices.label: Wrap it behind one interface
choices.consequence: Spend 2 focus. Future swaps cost nothing.

choices.label: Leave it alone
choices.consequence: Infra pressure rises for the rest of the act.

events.title: The Metrics Request
events.body: Leadership wants a dashboard by Friday. Nobody has said which decision it informs.

choices.label: Build the dashboard
choices.consequence: Gain 3 focus. Gain the Unasked Question curse.

choices.label: Ask what decision it informs
choices.consequence: Requires a Record Decision card. Removes a curse if you carry one.

events.title: The Inherited Suite
events.body: Four hundred tests. Six minutes. Nobody remembers what eleven of them assert.

choices.label: Delete the eleven
choices.consequence: Faster runs. Gain the Deleted Unknowns curse.

choices.label: Characterize them
choices.consequence: Requires a Characterization card. Gain a relic.

choices.label: Keep them and move on
choices.consequence: The suite stays slow. Nothing else changes.

events.title: The Good Enough Fix
events.body: There is a two-line patch that stops the bleeding and a two-day fix that stops the bug.

choices.label: Ship the two-liner
choices.consequence: Clear this floor free. Gain the Symptom Patch curse.

choices.label: Take the two days
choices.consequence: Spend 2 focus. Bug pressure drops for the act.

choices.label: Patch now, file the real fix
choices.consequence: Honest, and it costs a card slot.
